text: dsh-model-grid 为 DSH 网页界面增加按提供方分组的响应式模型卡片菜单。插件在 host 侧监听 webserver/index-inject 并注入样式，不改客户端 bundle。它支持 DSH 自带及 dsh-peakrate 两种菜单，可调菜单尺寸、卡片宽度和间距，也可隐藏价格倒计时或关闭样式。适合希望更直观浏览模型的 DSH 网页用户。需 Node.js 22 以上并加入 web profile bundles；无需 API key。

dsh-model-grid formats the DSH web model picker as provider-grouped responsive cards. It injects CSS on page response, supports the stock and dsh-peakrate menus, and lets users tune dimensions, spacing, and countdown visibility. Requires Node.js 22+; no API key.
想把 DSH 的模型下拉列表改成按提供方分组的卡片网格。
模型选择菜单太长不好浏览，能不能让卡片自动排成多列？
How can I make the DSH model menu easier to scan by grouping model cards into responsive columns?
dsh-model-grid 的功能「模型菜单卡片网格」：将模型选择菜单中的每个提供方分组排成响应式多列卡片，并让分组标题横跨整行。适用于自带选择器和 dsh-peakrate 菜单。
dsh-model-grid 的功能「网页样式注入与布局配置」：在页面注入时加入样式，可配置菜单尺寸、卡片最小宽度、间距、价格倒计时显示和启用状态。

Turn the composer model picker in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) from a long one-per-row list into a responsive **card grid**, grouped by provider.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

dsh-model-grid README · Features：- **Responsive grid.** As many columns as fit the popup (`auto-fill`), never fewer than one, so it degrades gracefully on narrow windows.
- **Grouped by provider.** Each provider keeps its own section; the provider heading spans the full row.
- **Works with both pickers.** The stock `dsh-client-ui-model-selection` dropdown *and* the third-party `dsh-peakrate` model menu (which replaces the stock trigger when installed). The stylesheet does not depend on either plugin being present.
- **Configurable.** Width, card width, gap, height cap, and whether to hide the long price countdown.
- **Host-only, upgrade-safe.** A single `<style>` is injected into the page `<head>` through the `webserver/index-inject` event. No client bundle is rebuilt, so it keeps working after DSH updates.
- **No runtime dependencies.**

dsh-model-grid README · Supported pickers：| Picker | What identifies it | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stock `dsh-client-ui-model-selection` | `[data-menu-group]` sections, `[role="menuitemradio"]` buttons | Attribute-based selectors, so hashed CSS-module class names don't matter. |
| `dsh-peakrate` model menu | `.dsh-peakrate-ms-menu`, `.dsh-peakrate-ms-group`, `.dsh-peakrate-ms-option` | Optional; this plugin never depends on it. |

dsh-model-grid README · Supported pickers：The rules are scoped so the two-cell root pane (Model / Reasoning effort) of the peakrate menu keeps its normal narrow width — only the grouped model list is widened.

dsh-model-grid README · Install：This is a DSH **profile plugin**. It is host-only, and the web UI must live at the bundle layer to appear, so it needs to be in `dsh.profile.bundles`.

```sh
dsh-model-grid README · 1. add the dependency to a profile：dsh plugin --profile web add github:anonamerjaxon-dev/dsh-model-grid
section: 1. add the dependency to a profile

text:
dsh-model-grid README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json, then restart the profile：dsh web
```

If you prefer a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-model-grid
```

Then add the same `"dsh-model-grid"` entry to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart.

> Restarting the profile is required: the host plugin is loaded at boot and the stylesheet is injected when the page is served.
dsh-model-grid README · Configuration：Options are passed through the plugin entry's `config` and merged with the defaults.

dsh-model-grid README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxWidth` | `900` | Hard cap on the popup width, in CSS px (clamped 240–4000). |
| `minCardWidth` | `200` | Minimum width of a model card, in CSS px (clamped 80–1200). |
| `gap` | `6` | Gap between cards, in CSS px (clamped 0–64). |
| `maxHeightVh` | `76` | Popup height cap, in `vh` (clamped 20–100). |
| `hideCountdown` | `true` | Hide the long "· 14h 23m" countdown in the price badge. |
| `enabled` | `true` | When `false`, nothing is injected. |

dsh-model-grid README · Configuration：Example — in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: model-grid
      name: 'dsh-model-grid'
      config:

dsh-model-grid README · How it works：1. `apply(ctx, config)` listens for the host's `webserver/index-inject` event.
2. On every index response, the listener pushes one `{ kind: "style", text }` row.
3. DSH renders that row as a `<style>` block in `<head>`.

Because the CSS is generated from `css.js` at injection time, there is no file I/O and nothing to keep in sync. `buildCss()` is exported and unit-tested independently of the host.

dsh-model-grid README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (declared in `package.json` → `dsh.compatibility`).
- Node.js **>= 22**.
- No bundler, no client build step.

dsh-model-grid README · Development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/anonamerjaxon-dev/dsh-model-grid.git
cd dsh-model-grid
node --test
```

The test suite covers config defaults/clamping, both picker selector sets, the countdown toggle, and the injection table.
